name: Tearout - Filtered resample fill
description: Reference checklist for a filtered tearout fill: resample a heavy bass, band-pass it into a weak phone-like build, then return to the dry hard bass at the drop. Not executable.

manual.instruction: Resample a finished gun or growl to audio. Duplicate the resample so the dry drop version and the filtered fill version are independent.
manual.verify: The fill uses the same sound as the drop but can be processed destructively.
manual.why: MOONBOY resamples the layered bass, then makes filtered fills from the resample.

manual.instruction: Band-pass the fill heavily, phone-like, and automate it to open or thin out over the fill. Keep it quiet and weak compared with the drop.
manual.verify: The fill creates expectation instead of competing with the main bass.
manual.why: MOONBOY uses a band-pass phone filter on the resampled bass as a pre-drop fill.

manual.instruction: Add a disperser to the resampled fill for a watery, less digital transient. Automate pitch or filter movement across the fill so it does not loop statically.
manual.verify: The fill moves and has a distinct texture from the dry drop.
manual.why: MOONBOY uses a disperser on resampled basses and pitch changes for variation.

manual.instruction: Place the fill in a four- or eight-bar gap, then cut to the dry hard bass on the drop. A/B the drop with and without the fill.
manual.verify: The drop hits harder with the fill than without it.
manual.why: The tutorial uses the filtered section to build expectation before the heavy drop.

manual.instruction: Check the fill and drop in mono and at low volume. If the fill is too loud, the drop loses impact; if it is too quiet, the transition disappears.
manual.verify: The contrast survives on small speakers and in mono.
manual.why: This is a contrast technique, so relative level matters more than the fill's solo sound.

notes: Source: MOONBOY, 'HOW TO TEAROUT DUBSTEP (Marauda, Kai Wachi, Excision)' (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nApsgDWSQ7Y). Transcript summary, not quotes. Reference-only because the engine cannot automate filters or place arrangement fills.
